name: adapt_moved_module_rust_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the module the agent's first solution uses is MOVED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, old module deleted, new one created); the agent must update its `mod`/path reference, not keep pointing at the old location
prompts: src/pricing.rs exports a const DISCOUNT; src/lib.rs already has `mod pricing;`. Add a function `pub fn apply_discount(price: f64) -> f64` to src/lib.rs that returns price * (1.0 - pricing::DISCOUNT).
src/pricing.rs has moved to src/config.rs (same DISCOUNT value). Update src/lib.rs to use `mod config;` and config::DISCOUNT instead - remove the old `mod pricing;` declaration.
